scope: Independent read-only review of exact retry parameter discovery, optional core scheduling, generic parameter guidance, advisory contract refresh, and the test-only no-physics observer recipe. No production writes during review.
verified: Only the exact current ordinary retry source yields a ready v1 contract: action_name=ui_accept, target_scene_id empty, state_values_json={"score":0,"health":100}; all three are String with referenceKind empty. Single leading BOM and uniform CRLF are reversible read-only representations. Other edits/lookalikes return null without export inference, markers or code evaluation.

requiresScriptParameterCore is animation-marker-only. The service uses it for the lazy adapter import, so a retry-only saved catalog does not require optional WASM; unavailable animation assistance cannot remove exact retry defaults.
The generic guidance describes explicit addition of missing defaults and ordinary review/Save. The existing complete-animation hint remains only for ready all-animation-clip contracts.

Successful Check first verifies the ordinary dependency signature, then refreshes only changed optional source descriptions. It preserves the session, saved scene descriptor, source snapshot, parameter DOM/values and ordinary dependencyRevision; unchanged source descriptions retain their original identity.

Contract withdrawal, revival and changed defaults replace the selected source description, so old Add/Rename controls lose their source/contract ownership. Another source’s advisory-only change leaves the active helper and pending rename choice intact.

Advisory metadata remains excluded from ordinary dependency comparison. It does not veto an otherwise current ordinary proposal; explicit Add/Rename still invalidates review through the established local form path. Real saved source edits continue to change dependencyRevision and reject stale Apply.
No persistent interface, source marker, canonical starter, runtime port/protocol, backend capability or author registration change is introduced.

observerRecipeReview.status: static review of recipe and existing runtime schedule; not an independently executed native test
observerRecipeReview.conclusion: For the no-physics two-scene HUD project, replacing exactly the two _physics_process identifiers in the existing read-only observer with _process forwards super._process(delta) once. Project runtime performs current.project_step(delta) once; the observer performs no extra project step, binding step, event/state mutation or queue flush.
observerRecipeReview.execution: The recipe calls the adapter’s existing executePhase for each build phase and runBuildProcess for the actual keyboard driver. It rechecks every originally generated file and all author bytes after execution. Screenshots await frame_post_draw and pair a fresh read-only JSON snapshot with that rendered frame.
observerRecipeReview.limits: The extra observer scene/script belongs only to the disposable generated copy. Xvfb/Mesa/XTest observation is not a physical device, installed app or full reference-game acceptance.

limitations: The focused batch uses actual controllers through a DOM harness plus saved v2/v3 temporary author copies over local HTTP. It does not itself prove browser/native/installation acceptance.
The complete application run and browser/native receipts are parent-owned and not certified by this memo.
BOM/CRLF advisory recognition does not expand the existing raw-byte official retry build-preflight recognizer; runtime and diagnostics remain unchanged.
No literal desktop-library project creation, complete from-blank collection game, same-scene restart, pause, persistent progress, long-running budget or standalone distribution is claimed.
